fusions.name: Slag Fling
fusions.desc: Flings molten slag up to 5 tiles that deals 4 damage, up to 1.4 times as much at full reach, sets the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and slows it by 15% for 1 second.

fusions.name: Hot Rivets
fusions.desc: Fires 3 red-hot rivets that spread apart, each dealing 25 damage that ignores armour and setting the target [Burning] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Glowing Plate
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Your armour rises by 10%, and you have 15% fire resistance.

fusions.name: Heat in the Bulwark
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, heat builds on you, up to 8 stacks. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
